title: Outbound message, schema ar-comms/0 (Overview C5, System Design 7). Staged by a card worker at comms/staged/<M-id>.json, published by the runtime at comms/outbox/<seq:08d>-<M-id>.json. Versioning is additive within ar-comms/0: writers may add optional fields and new kinds, and readers must ignore unknown fields and unknown kinds. The five outbound kinds are note, question, suggestion, help_request and highlight. Writers check the kind against that list (autoresearch.comms.envelope.KINDS); this schema does not, so a reader that validates with it accepts a newer kind. Status (open, answered, withdrawn, expired) is never stored: it is derived from later messages (Task 3.7).

created.description: ISO 8601 time the message was written.

iteration.description: Iteration (journal iteration) of the card run that wrote it; null if none (runtime messages).

body.description: Markdown written for the Preston-role agent.

rev.description: Workspace commit the reference is read at. A staged message may use "@result" (the commit its card merges as); the publisher replaces it with that merge commit.

priority.description: Same scale as card priority: P0 (most urgent) to P5.

in_reply_to.description: Id of the message or inbound (I-id) this answers. An acknowledgement is a note with in_reply_to.

supersedes.description: Id of an earlier message this one replaces (that message becomes withdrawn).

expires.description: ISO 8601 time after which an unanswered message is expired; null for never.

seq.description: Outbox only: the gap-free sequence number.

published_rev.description: Outbox only: canonical commit the message was published at (for a staged message, the merge commit that brought it in).
